stemMarkdown: Next year total expenditure rises by 20% and salaries fall to 35% of the total. What will the company then spend on salaries, in Rs lakh?
solutionMarkdown:
New total: $250 \times 1.2 = 300$ lakh.

$300 \times \dfrac{35}{100} = 105$

**Rs 105 lakh**, against Rs 100 lakh this year. Salaries fall by 5 percentage points of the pie and still cost 5% more in rupees, because the pie itself got bigger.
